label: Demonstration notice
definition_or_allowed_values: Fictional illustration only; not live research or cleared delivery
boundary: Retain this label in every exported example row.

label: Record identifier
definition_or_allowed_values: Locally unique educational record ID
boundary: Not a campaign or delivered-lead identifier.

label: Record unit
definition_or_allowed_values: company | facility
boundary: The worked examples use company; agree the unit before deduplication.

label: Company or site
definition_or_allowed_values: Business or site being assessed
boundary: No named persons; fictional labels in the worked rows.

label: Industry or activity
definition_or_allowed_values: Activity needed to test the profile
boundary: An industry label alone does not establish equipment demand.

label: Territory
definition_or_allowed_values: Country or geography relevant to the brief
boundary: A preference is not a coverage commitment.

label: Profile reference
definition_or_allowed_values: Reference to the written fit criteria and exclusions
boundary: DEMO-PROFILE-01 is invented; a real brief needs its own version.

label: Fit rationale
definition_or_allowed_values: Source-supported explanation of why the account matches
boundary: Do not infer intent from fit.

label: Source references
definition_or_allowed_values: Approved source IDs or permitted links supporting material fields
boundary: DEMO-SOURCE identifiers are invented statements, not retrieved sources.

label: Source publication date
definition_or_allowed_values: ISO date of the evidence; unknown stays explicit in a real record
boundary: Blank in fiction because no source was published.

label: Source review date
requirement: Required for a real reviewed record
definition_or_allowed_values: ISO date of actual retrieval/review
boundary: Never invent a review timestamp; blank in fiction.

label: Evidence-use status
requirement: Must be resolved before real use
definition_or_allowed_values: Applicable source and customer-use posture
boundary: Fictional labels do not clear a real source or provider; unknown means hold.

label: Research class
definition_or_allowed_values: fit_matched_lookalike | opportunity_signal
boundary: Rejected examples carry the tested class only, not an accepted delivery slot.

label: Project research state
definition_or_allowed_values: not_assessed_not_required | bounded_review_no_qualifying_signal_identified | qualifying_signal_identified
boundary: Only opportunity_signal may use qualifying_signal_identified; no signal found does not mean no project exists.

label: Observed fact
requirement: Required where an evidence claim is made
definition_or_allowed_values: What the referenced evidence actually says
boundary: In fiction this is an explicitly invented source statement.

label: Interpretation
definition_or_allowed_values: Bounded commercial interpretation kept separate from facts
boundary: Not technical suitability, an open package or intent.

label: Known unknowns
definition_or_allowed_values: Unresolved material fit, source or project questions
boundary: Unknown is not a pass or a negative finding.

label: Illustrative decision
definition_or_allowed_values: illustrative_accept | illustrative_reject | needs_review
boundary: These labels are not the canonical internal qa_status or delivery approval.

label: Decision reason
definition_or_allowed_values: Specific passed or failed written criterion
boundary: A shared product keyword cannot rescue a mismatch.

label: Next verification step
definition_or_allowed_values: Smallest useful check before relying on the record
boundary: Does not authorise named-person research or outreach.

label: Next evidence review
definition_or_allowed_values: ISO date or scoped trigger recorded separately
boundary: Blank in fiction; no universal review or replacement SLA.
